grammar.title: 一般过去时态
lines: 一般过去时态 动词 过去式 的变化规则 (不规则动词表) 一般现在时态 （复习对比） 不规则动词练习(请转为一般现在时)
过去（经常）的状态 过去（习惯）的动作
主语 + was\were + 非动词 主语 + did (v.过去式)

I was home. They were at school. She was Pretty. It was great. She was right . Michelle visit ed China in 2014. 2014 访问了中国 I watch ed “Toy story 3” last month. 我上个月看过了“玩具总动员” I clean ed my room this morning. 今天早上我打扫了房间 She help ed me yesterday. 她昨天帮助了我 They enjoy ed themselves last weekend. 上周他们玩得很开心
一般情况 + ed call → called; air → aired I air ed the room this morning. 我上午给房间通风了。
以字母 e 结尾 + d live → lived; love → loved They liv ed in New York two years ago. 他们两年前居住在纽约。
以辅音字母+ y 结尾,变 y 为 i +ed try → tried; study → studied I stud ied in the US in 2010. 我 2010 年在美国学习。
辅+元+辅（汉堡包结构),将辅音字母双写+ed stop → stopped The bus stop ped just now. 公车刚刚停下来了。
陈述句 否定句(Don’t \Doesn’t + do) 一般疑问句(Do\does + do？)
I watch ed “Toy story 3” last month . I did n’t watch “Toy story 3” last month. Did Michelle visit China in 2014?
I clean ed my room this morning . I did n’t clean my room this morning. Did you clean your room this morning?
She help ed me yesterday. She did n’t help me yesterday. Did she help you yesterday?
They enjoy ed themselves last weekend . They did n’t enjoy themselves last weekend. Did they enjoy themselves last weekend?
I went to Hollywood nine years ago. → ?
I made a snow man last winter. → ?

sentences.title: When did you…?
lines: When did you air the room? → I air ed the room in the morning .
When did you clean your shoes? → I clean ed my shoes in the afternoon .
When did you open the box? → I open ed the box just now .
It is raining . → It rain ed yesterday.
It is snowing . → It snow ed yesterday.
He is boiling some eggs. → He boil ed some eggs yesterday.
? → We enjoy ed it yesterday, too.

expand.title: 电话用语
lines: 中文 电话用语
你好！我是 Venus。 Hello. It’s Venus. This is Venus.
请问李先生在吗？ Is Mr. Lee in?
请问您是哪位？ Who is calling please?
我是他的朋友，Venus. It’s his friend, Venus.
请稍等。 Please hold on.
对不起他去开会了。 Sorry, he is in a meeting.
那好吧，请让他一会给我打过来好吗？ OK,tell him to call me later, please.
好的。 Ok. Bye.
Where there is a will, there is a way. 世上无难事，只要肯登攀。
